result.summary: Backports eight merged pull requests to the 32.x release branch: #36277, #36303, #36404, #36435, #36340, #36392, #36462, and #36471. result.card: Backports eight pull requests to the 32.x release branch (#36277, #36303, #36404, #36435, #36340, #36392, #36462, #36471). Fixes include ensuring private broadcast completes all three initial outbound connections and handles retry disconnects correctly, capping Sock::WaitMany timeout so bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0 works on macOS and BSD systems, correcting bitcoin-util genesis hash byte order, and adjusting OpenRPC hex schema patterns. It also resolves CI container subnet collisions and test harness shutdown issues.
